# Profile Page

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ProfilePage`](gmeow-ProfilePage.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ProfilePage>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)
- **Box roles:** [ConfigBox role](../boxes/boxconfigbox.md), [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A web page whose principal subject is an agent — a person's or organization's profile/about page. A DEFINED class: any [`gmeow:WebPage`](gmeow-WebPage.md) whose [`gmeow:pagePrincipalSubject`](../properties/gmeow-pagePrincipalSubject.md) is a [`gmeow:Agent`](gmeow-Agent.md) IS a [`ProfilePage`](gmeow-ProfilePage.md) (≡ [`gmeow:WebPage`](gmeow-WebPage.md) ⊓ ∃[`gmeow:pagePrincipalSubject`](../properties/gmeow-pagePrincipalSubject.md).[`gmeow:Agent`](gmeow-Agent.md)), so no manual typing is needed. Projects to [schema:ProfilePage.](https://schema.org/ProfilePage.)

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:WebPage`](gmeow-WebPage.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ProfilePage`](gmeow-ProfilePage.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:WebPage`](gmeow-WebPage.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the QUERY target for any page that profiles an agent; membership is derived, so reach for it when selecting or projecting profile/about pages rather than to type them by hand.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting [rdf:type](http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#type) [`gmeow:ProfilePage`](gmeow-ProfilePage.md) manually — it is a defined class inferred from [`gmeow:pagePrincipalSubject`](../properties/gmeow-pagePrincipalSubject.md) ranging over a [`gmeow:Agent`](gmeow-Agent.md); assert the principal subject instead and let the reasoner classify.

### How to use

- Do not type instances directly: give a [`gmeow:WebPage`](gmeow-WebPage.md) a [`gmeow:pagePrincipalSubject`](../properties/gmeow-pagePrincipalSubject.md) that is a [`gmeow:Agent`](gmeow-Agent.md) and the equivalence axiom classifies it as a [`ProfilePage`](gmeow-ProfilePage.md), which projects to [schema:ProfilePage.](https://schema.org/ProfilePage.)
